summary: Executed requested native/backend regression pass for v0.6.0 scope: reran native unit tests and assembleDebug/assembleRelease, validated 20 backend native contracts against external preview URL, ran frontend smoke load, and verified artifact metadata/signature/alignment/CRC outputs.

integration_issues.issue: Intermittent failure in MainActivityRobolectricTest.restore_to_home_open_detail_and_back_restores_focus_and_scroll; fails in full suite with focus acquisition assertion and Robolectric reports unexecuted main-looper runnables.
Code review found TrailerWarmup.prime() and TrailerRail warm calls limiting prewarm input to 2 titles (take(2)), but requirement specifies current + next 2 (max 3).

issues: Container cannot prove real Android TV decoder/first-frame latency or pixel-perfect typography/spacing; browser smoke is only login-page load evidence.

action_items: Fix native test flake/root cause around focus readiness in MainActivityRobolectricTest path (likely pending main-looper tasks before requestFocus).
Update trailer warmup logic to include current + next two titles (max 3) as per approved behavior, then add explicit regression assertion.
If final deliverable needs signed release artifact, run signing step after assembleRelease (current output is app-release-unsigned.apk, expected unsigned at this build stage).
Resolve Android platform-tools license warning in CI/container for cleaner deterministic build logs.
critical_code_review_comments: Trailer warmup scope currently under-prefetches (2 instead of required 3 titles), risking slower trailer start on rapid directional navigation.
MainActivity focus restoration test is unstable in suite runs and may mask real focus race conditions.
Release BuildConfig correctly keeps DEBUG_PREFILL disabled and empty while debug keeps prefill enabled (expected split).

success_rate.frontend: Frontend smoke passed; native unit suite unstable (129/130 passed, 1 intermittent failure), assembleDebug+assembleRelease passed

context_for_next_testing_agent: Used REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env and VESPER_TEST_USERNAME/VESPER_TEST_PASSWORD from memory/test_credentials.md. Commands run: 1) gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:assembleDebug :app:assembleRelease (failed with 1 intermittent focus test) 2) gradlew targeted test for failing case (passed) 3) gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest rerun (same intermittent failure) 4) gradlew :app:assembleDebug :app:assembleRelease -x test (passed) 5) pytest on four required backend files (20/20 pass). Artifact metadata confirms versionCode 10/versionName 0.6.0-native-private. Debug signer digest unchanged. Release artifact from this run is unsigned.
rca of the issue: Intermittent unit failure reproduces only in full-suite context; failure assertion is at focus request for first poster tile, and junit includes Robolectric warning about queued unexecuted runnables. This indicates a UI scheduling race rather than deterministic logic break. Separate critical miss from code review: trailer warmup currently calls take(2), which conflicts with requirement to preload current+next2 and can directly reduce warmup effectiveness under rapid D-pad movement. Also, native unit network/extractor fixtures are MOCKED in tests; runtime integrations are real.
